thesis: AMPH is a fundamentally improving, cheap, profitable company in a confirmed uptrend that is pulling back to support while the market is risk-off. Q3 net income rose 117.6% YoY on accelerating sequential revenue, and forward P/E is 8.4. The 5.4% drop on 11-19 has no identified news, so it looks like a pullback toward SMA20 and the 27.80 swing low, not a thesis break. The entry zone 27.9-28.3 with a stop at 27.5 gives a favourable reward/risk to the 31.0 52-week high. The setup is only moderate: the regime is risk-off, the first test of 31.0 failed, and the stop is tight. It should only be taken small, and only after a hold of 27.8-28.0.
